deletion_gate_definition.avqds: not applicable because the locked AVQDS route is append-only
deletion_gate_definition.completeness: exact only when every checkpoint has one selector invocation and its persisted attempt list equals declared attempt_count; the current multi-round loop retains only the final invocation
deletion_gate_definition.post_delete_failure: a deletion-bearing finalist rejected by certification or the realized-authority gate after pre-certification resolution

estimator_work_definition.avqds_candidate_acquisition: sum_r c_r*g(p_r+1) over every persisted greedy round; exact for complete new receipts and a lower bound for legacy ones
estimator_work_definition.certification: sum_a g(p_a) over every completed finalist geometry; exact for complete new receipts and a lower bound for legacy ones
estimator_work_definition.checkpoint_base: sum_k g(p_k); exact from pre-edit support
estimator_work_definition.generalized_exchange_candidate_acquisiti: sum_k [p_k*M_k + M_k*(M_k+3)/2] over every persisted shared positioned-tangent cache; exact for complete new receipts
estimator_work_definition.integration: sum_i r_i * g(p_i); exact from RHS telemetry
estimator_work_definition.local_refit: sum_a r_a*(p_a+1) over instrumented finalist-refit objective callbacks; reported separately from full geometry
estimator_work_definition.meaning: logical scalar-geometry entries, not physical shots
estimator_work_definition.physical_shots: unavailable: these runs use dense statevector evaluation and persist no estimator circuits, commuting groups, precision, or shot allocation
estimator_work_definition.total: integration + checkpoint base + candidate acquisition + certification + local refit; status records exact versus lower bound
